verdict.rationale: Docs describe redirecting users to their bank's own login screen for consent (create-bulk-payment-authorisation, create-embedded-account-authorisation) and automatic handling of Strong Customer Authentication/bank redirects, implying bank-hosted authentication rather than screen-scraping, but nowhere do the docs use the term 'OAuth', quantify coverage across institutions, or discuss retirement of legacy credential-sharing flows. Missing for 10: explicit OAuth terminology/coverage stats, any mention of legacy screen-scraping methods being deprecated, and independent confirmation of bank-hosted OAuth across the institution network.
